```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'tests/**'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - 'AGENTS.md'
      - 'justfile'
      - '.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'tests/**'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - 'AGENTS.md'
      - 'justfile'
      - '.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml'

jobs:
  copilot-setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v2
        with:
          rust-version: stable

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install Rust dependencies
        run: cargo fetch

      - name: Install Node dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Generate Rust documentation
        run: |
          cargo doc --no-deps --document-private-items
          mkdir -p artifacts/rust_docs
          cp -r target/doc/* artifacts/rust_docs/

      - name: Extract TypeScript definitions
        run: |
          npx tsc --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir artifacts/ts_defs
          mkdir -p artifacts/ts_docs
          npx typedoc --out artifacts/ts_docs src/**/*.ts

      - name: Analyze code structure
        run: |
          mkdir -p artifacts/code_structure
          find src -type f -printf "%p\n" > artifacts/code_structure/src_files.txt
          find tests -type f -printf "%p\n" > artifacts/code_structure/test_files.txt

      - name: Extract configuration
        run: |
          mkdir -p artifacts/config
          # Cargo.toml
          echo "=== Cargo.toml ===" > artifacts/config/config_summary.txt
          grep -E '^\[package\]|^name:|^version:|^edition:' Cargo.toml >> artifacts/config/config_summary.txt
          # package.json
          echo "=== package.json ===" >> artifacts/config/config_summary.txt
          jq '.name, .version, .dependencies, .devDependencies' package.json >> artifacts/config/config_summary.txt

      - name: Gather test information
        run: |
          mkdir -p artifacts/tests
          find tests -type f -printf "%p\n" > artifacts/tests/test_files.txt

      - name: Validate AGENTS.md sections
        run: |
          REQUIRED_SECTIONS=(
            "## Project Overview"
            "## Development Workflow"
            "## Code Conventions"
            "## Testing Strategy"
            "## Common Patterns"
            "## Performance Considerations"
            "## Debugging"
          )
          MISSING=()
          for section in "${REQUIRED_SECTIONS[@]}"; do
            if ! grep -q "$section" AGENTS.md; then
              MISSING+=("$section")
            fi
          done
          if [ ${#MISSING[@]} -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "Missing required sections in AGENTS.md:" >&2
            printf '%s\n' "${MISSING[@]}" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Package AI context bundle
        run: |
          mkdir -p artifacts/bundle
          cp -r artifacts/rust_docs artifacts/bundle/
          cp -r artifacts/ts_defs artifacts/bundle/
          cp -r artifacts/ts_docs artifacts/bundle/
          cp -r artifacts/code_structure artifacts/bundle/
          cp -r artifacts/config artifacts/bundle/
          cp -r artifacts/tests artifacts/bundle/
          cp AGENTS.md artifacts/bundle/
          tar -czf artifacts/ai_context_bundle.tar.gz -C artifacts/bundle .

      - name: Upload AI context bundle
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ai-context-bundle
          path: artifacts/ai_context_bundle.tar.gz
          retention-days: 7
```
